queries:
SELECT order_id,
       AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS order_avg,
       AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) - (SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) FROM Order_Items) AS diff
FROM Order_Items
GROUP BY order_id
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT AVG(product_quantity) FROM Order_Items;
SELECT oi.order_item_id,
       CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL) - a.avg_qty AS difference
FROM Order_Items oi
JOIN (
    SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty
    FROM Order_Items
    GROUP BY order_id
) a ON oi.order_id = a.order_id
WHERE a.avg_qty IS NOT NULL;
SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_count
FROM Orders o
LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY o.order_id
